notes: Normal row count intentionally includes Complete, Early Access, and Base Only characters only.
Role, strength, and limit fields summarize source-backed mechanics from moves, HP, status, domains, and individual-page pros/cons. Unsupported tier-list ranks are not stored as facts.
Images are local row-specific wiki character images converted by the CDN as WebP files and kept only when the source image was tied to the exact row.

items.name: Honored One
items.baseMoves: 1: Lapse Blue; 2: Reversal Red; 3: Rapid Punches; 4: Twofold Kick; R: Limitless
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Six Eyes: Lapse Blue MAX, Reversal Red MAX, Hollow Purple, Infinite Void, Limitless, Unlimited Purple, 0.2 Domain
items.strength: Blue, Red, Purple, and Infinite Void give clear ranged and domain pressure.
items.limit: Strong tools still need clean spacing because predictable ranged pressure can be blocked, baited, or interrupted.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Vessel
items.baseMoves: 1: Cursed Strikes; 2: Crushing Blow; 3: Divergent Fist; 4: Manji Kick; R: Combat Instincts
items.awakeningOrSpecial: King of Curses: Dismantle, Open, Rush, Malevolent Shrine, Cleave, World Cutting Slash
items.strength: Cleave, Dismantle, and Malevolent Shrine turn a close-range confirm into heavy awakening pressure.
items.limit: 85 HP and mostly melee base tools make bad entries expensive.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Restless Gambler
items.baseMoves: 1: Reserve Balls; 2: Shutter Doors; 3: Rough Energy; 4: Fever Breaker; R: Door Guard
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Idle Death Gamble: Lucky Volley, Lucky Rushdown, Overwhelming Luck, Energy Surge, Rhythm
items.strength: Idle Death Gamble and the lucky awakening tools reward momentum after a clean setup.
items.limit: Base pressure needs confirms before the domain and luck tools take over.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Ten Shadows
items.baseMoves: 1: Rabbit Escape; 2: Nue; 3: Toad; 4: Divine Dog: Totality; R: Lurking Shadow
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Insanity: Max Elephant, Great Serpent, Shadow Swarm, Mahoraga, Lurking Shadow, Switch; Mahoraga mode: Divine Pummel, Ground Pitch, Earthquake, Takedown / Adaptation / World Slash, Adaptation Wheel
items.domain: Chimera Shadow Garden interaction on domain border
items.strength: Shikigami tools cover space, and Mahoraga adds a second mode after awakening.
items.limit: 85 HP and a busier kit make it harder to learn before simpler complete characters.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Perfection
items.baseMoves: 1: Stockpile; 2: Soul Fire; 3: Focus Strike; 4: Body Repel; R: Self-Transfiguration
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Essence of the Soul: Idle Transfiguration, Body Disfigure, Spike Wrath, Embodiment of Self Perfection, Awakening Black Flash; Instant Spirit Body: Widespread Strikes, Face Blitz, Crushing Rushdown, Head Splitter
items.strength: Transfiguration tools and the second form give layered offense after awakening.
items.limit: Form changes and domain timing add more to manage than a simple starter pick.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Blood Manipulator
items.baseMoves: 1: Piercing Blood; 2: Flowing Red Scale; 3: Supernova; 4: Blood Edge; R: Convergence
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Duty As A Brother: Slicing Exorcism, Wing King, Blood Rain, Plasma Wave, Convergence
items.strength: Piercing Blood, Supernova, Blood Rain, and Plasma Wave give clear projectile and area pressure.
items.limit: Needs spacing and timing because rushed setups can be interrupted up close.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Switcher
items.baseMoves: 1: Swift Kick; 2: Brute Force; 3: Pebble Throw; 4: Elbow Drop; R: Boogie Woogie
items.awakeningOrSpecial: False Memories: Idol's Debut, Climax Jumping, Dreams, Brothers, Boogie Woogie
items.strength: Boogie Woogie changes positions and makes enemy habits easier to punish.
items.limit: Timing matters more than raw move names, so it can feel unclear for a first moveset.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Defense Attorney
items.baseMoves: 1: Extended Swings; 2: Justice Served; 3: Judgement's Reach; 4: Pressing Charges; R: No Escape
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Deadly Sentencing: Execution, Final Judgement, Verdict, Triple Sentence, Domain Amplification
items.strength: No Escape, Verdict, and Deadly Sentencing punish enemy action after a setup.
items.limit: 90 HP and judgement tools reward setup knowledge more than button-mashing.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Cursed Partners
items.baseMoves: 1: Severing Path; 2: Resolute Slash; 3: Outburst; 4: Second Wind; R: Rika plus Rika follow-ups
items.awakeningOrSpecial: True Love: Elbow Rush, Copy, Energy Ripple, Authentic Mutual Love, Rika follow-ups, Copy Wheel
items.strength: Rika follow-ups and Copy Wheel add extra options around the normal four-skill kit.
items.limit: 90 HP and partner follow-ups can overwhelm players who are still learning basic confirms.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Puppet Master
items.baseMoves: 1: Ultra Spin; 2: Boost On; 3: Ultra Cannon; 4: Heat Emission; R: Offload
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Absolute: Miracle Cannon, Pigeon Viola, Absolute Destruction, Technique Charge, Energy Output
items.strength: Ultra Cannon, Heat Emission, and Absolute moves give strong projectile pressure.
items.limit: 85 base HP means the stronger awakening health does not save poor neutral before G is ready.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Head of the Hei
items.baseMoves: 1: Projection Breaker; 2: Bleedout; 3: Decisive Strike; 4: Cursory Impact; R: Projection Sorcery
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Vengeance: Top Speed, Flash Freezing, Tendril Grab, Time Cell Moon Palace, Acceleration
items.strength: Projection Sorcery, Top Speed, and Acceleration reward chase timing and fast punishment.
items.limit: Awakening HP drops to 75, so missed pressure becomes more dangerous after transforming.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Salaryman
items.baseMoves: 1: Cleaving Whirlwind; 2: Severance Kick; 3: Blunt Cut; 4: Stabilize; R: Ratio Point
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Overtime: Ratio Breaker, Sharpen, Interrogate, Collapse, Ratio Point
items.strength: Ratio Point, Stabilize, and Overtime reward clean confirms without a separate domain layer.
items.limit: No full domain is listed, so wins depend more on neutral and consistent confirms.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: True Cannon
items.baseMoves: 1: Granite Blast; 2: Unsatisfied; 3: Second Helping; 4: Appetizer; R: Restyle
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Every Last Drop: What are you after?, I had no idea..., This is what dessert is like!, You weren't invited., Restyle
items.strength: Granite Blast, Restyle, and the finished awakening give ranged pressure plus a complete G route.
items.limit: The quoted awakening move names are less readable at a glance, so players should learn the base confirms first.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Disaster Plants
items.baseMoves: 1: Root Swam; 2: Surging Thorns; 3: Bud Shot; 4: Defense Response; R: Flower Field
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Unwrap: awakening moves are listed as TBA; Flower Field is the current base special
items.strength: Roots, thorns, and Flower Field point toward space control before the full awakening is finished.
items.limit: Early Access and TBA awakening moves mean the row can change more than completed characters.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, Early Access cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Locust Guy
items.baseMoves: 1: Clever; 2: Black Mucus; 3: Crushing Jaws; 4: Wing Throw; R: Fluttering Pounce
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Directed Poison special on awakening; no full awakened moveset listed
items.domain: No full domain listed; base-only special instead
items.strength: Fluttering Pounce and the wing tools support quick engage and disengage windows.
items.limit: Base-only status means there is no full awakened kit to compare against complete characters.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Star Rage
items.baseMoves: 1: Garuda Rebound; 2: Rising Rage; 3: Mass Breaker; 4: Garuda Stab; R: Mass Buildup
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Unrestricted Density special on awakening; no full awakened moveset listed
items.domain: No full domain listed; base-only special instead
items.strength: Garuda and mass tools give a simple heavy-hit identity for base-only play.
items.limit: No full awakened move list, so the comparison is mostly base moves plus one special.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Aspiring Mangaka
items.baseMoves: 1: Despair; 2: Shut Up!; 3: Eye Catching; 4: Sacrilege; R: Clairvoyance
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Foresight awakening counter; no full awakened moveset listed
items.domain: No full domain listed; base-only special instead
items.strength: Clairvoyance, Oracle, and counter moves reward reads, perfect blocks, and forced movement.
items.limit: 85 HP and counter reliance make it technical for players still learning neutral.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Lucky Coward
items.baseMoves: 1: Ambush; 2: Backstab; 3: Trip; 4: Cheap Shot; R: Helping Hand plus follow-ups
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Jawbreaker special on awakening; no full awakened moveset listed
items.domain: No full domain listed; base-only special instead
items.strength: Ambush, Backstab, and Helping Hand branches reward surprise openings and follow-up choices.
items.limit: 70 HP leaves very little room for missed confirms or bad trades.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Crow Charmer
items.baseMoves: 1: Impetus Updraft; 2: Circling; 3: Gliding Flight; 4: Bird Control; R: Flock
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Bird Strike special on awakening; no full awakened moveset listed
items.domain: No full domain listed; base-only special instead
items.strength: Gliding Flight, Flock, and Bird Control make movement and aerial pressure the main identity.
items.limit: Base-only status and aerial setup mean timing matters more than a simple full-awakening plan.
items.verificationNote: Roster, moves, HP, cost, and image checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Black Death
items.baseMoves: 1: Festering Strikes; 2: Detach; 3: Chokehold; 4: Roach Swarm; R: Earthen Insect Trance
items.awakeningOrSpecial: Parthenogenesis special with Bugnado and Infestation domain interaction
items.domain: Infestation interaction on domain; no full domain listed
items.strength: Roach Swarm, Earthen Insect Trance, Bugnado, and Infestation give disruptive base-only utility.
items.limit: Newer base-only row should be rechecked after updates because its special interactions may change.
